# 06 — RBAC Matrix

<!-- GENERATED by `npm run docs:rbac` from src/modules/auth/domain/rbac.ts — do not edit by hand. -->

Every permission is enforced server-side in application use cases (`can()` / `authorize()` /
`scopeFor()`); hiding UI is never the control. Scopes: **any** = platform-wide,
**provider** = only the actor's provider, **own** = only the actor's own resources.

## Roles

| Code | Role | Scope | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| SA | SUPER_ADMIN | PLATFORM | Akses penuh, termasuk pengaturan sistem dan penetapan role. |
| AD | ADMIN | PLATFORM | Operasional marketplace: provider, paket, coverage, pesanan, konten. |
| CS | CUSTOMER_SUPPORT | PLATFORM | Menangani tiket, pesanan, dan instalasi pelanggan. |
| FI | FINANCE | PLATFORM | Pembayaran, refund, komisi, dan payout. |
| SL | SALES | PLATFORM | Leads, akuisisi provider, dan referral. |
| PO | PROVIDER_OWNER | PROVIDER | Akses penuh atas data providernya, termasuk pengguna. |
| PA | PROVIDER_ADMIN | PROVIDER | Mengelola paket, coverage, pesanan, dan instalasi provider. |
| PS | PROVIDER_SALES | PROVIDER | Leads dan konfirmasi pesanan provider. |
| PT | PROVIDER_TECHNICIAN | PROVIDER | Jadwal dan pelaksanaan instalasi. |
| CU | CUSTOMER | CUSTOMER | Memesan dan memantau layanan miliknya. |
| RP | REFERRAL_PARTNER | PARTNER | Melihat referral dan komisinya (Fase 3). |

## Additional rules enforced in code

- Provider roles grant nothing unless the user has an ACTIVE `provider_users` membership.
- Money-moving approvals (refund, payout) also require a different approver than the requester (four-eyes).
- `PAID` / `PAYMENT_FAILED` order states can only be set by the SYSTEM actor (verified webhook).
- Platform role changes are audited as `user_role_changed` with before/after.
